### Subquestion 3: If Rick Mears is on the Penske Racing team, check if he has won the greatest number of Indy 500 races.
Rick Mears has won the Indianapolis 500 four times (1979, 1984, 1988, 1991).

### Subquestion 4: If Rick Mears is not on the Penske Racing team, identify the driver on the Penske Racing team who has won the greatest number of Indy 500 races.
Since Rick Mears is on the Penske Racing team and has won the Indianapolis 500 four times, there is no need to look for another driver on the Penske Racing team.

### Final Answer:
The driver on the Penske Racing team in the 1979 Trenton Twin Indy who has won the greatest number of Indy 500 races is Rick Mears.
